derivation: or (shortened) דְּבֹרָה; from H1696 (דָבַר) (in the sense of orderly motion);

occurrences.text: And the Amorites, which dwelt in that mountain, came out against you, and chased you, as bees do, and destroyed you in Seir, even unto Hormah.
And after a time he returned to take her, and he turned aside to see the carcase of the lion: and, behold, there was a swarm of bees and honey in the carcase of the lion.
They compassed me about like bees; they are quenched as the fire of thorns: for in the name of the Lord I will destroy them.
And it shall come to pass in that day, that the Lord shall hiss for the fly that is in the uttermost part of the rivers of Egypt, and for the bee that is in the land of Assyria.
